niche.habitat: Upper to mid-cloud decks, near jet boundaries
niche.active: Continuous, follows prey herds and storm fronts

body: Sleek, torpedo-shaped predators with jagged hydrofoils and flank-mounted acoustic arrays. They harvest static from passing storms to charge ram-jets, then dive through wind shear to snatch prey before vanishing back into the gale.

Delivers short-duration kinetic strikes

skill.effect: Deals 22 damage in a 50 m radius with a 0.5 s wind-up

observe: Torn cloud vapor and shock rings

journal.en: They don't fly; they kick the atmosphere into submission.

links: Aerosol haze reduces visual range to tens of meters
